mapper.select: SELECT * FROM materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT m.id, m.title, m.course_tag as courseTag, LEFT(o.ocr_text, 200) as ocrTextSnippet, m.source, m.created_at as createdAt FROM materials m LEFT JOIN ocr_result o ON m.id = o.material_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND (MATCH(m.title) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR MATCH(o.ocr_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)) ORDER BY ( IFNULL(MATCH(m.title) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE), 0) * 0.6 + IFNULL(MATCH(o.ocr_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE), 0) * 0.4 ) DESC

SELECT m.id, m.title, m.course_tag as courseTag, LEFT(o.ocr_text, 200) as ocrTextSnippet, m.source, m.created_at as createdAt FROM materials m LEFT JOIN ocr_result o ON m.id = o.material_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND (m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.ocr_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
